eventLocation: Mariamman and Abhaya Anjaneyar Temple premises located in Mudichur Varadharajapuram area
eventDescription: In the premises of Mariamman and Abaya Anjaneyar Temple located in Mudichur Varadarajapuram, sacred Nakshatra trees such as Vanni (Prosopis cineraria), Vilvam (Bael tree), Athi (Fig tree), Naval (Jamun tree), and Nelli (Gooseberry tree) have been planted.
